ns2:section.sectionText: Priority for registration is given to ADV, CS+ADV, and Ag COMM majors who started their collegiate coursework prior to or in Fall 2019. If seats are available, they will be released to majors who began coursework in Fall 2020 and who have met the pre-requisites on May 6.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising or Agricultural Communications or Computer Science & Advertising or Ag Communications-Advertising major(s) or minor(s).
